steps.body_html:
• Find the fine, parallel grain in the red flesh.
  • Broad pale seams are connective tissue and are not a reliable grain guide.
  • Rotate the block so the cutting line crosses the fine grain at roughly 90°.
  • For the pictured cut, grain runs left–right and the knife crosses front–back.
  • Keep guiding fingers tucked behind the edge.
  • Draw the knife through once, heel to tip, making 5–7 mm slices.
  • If the grain is unclear, ask the fishmonger to identify it.
